items.sentence: The library provides students with a quiet place to study.
items.prompt: provide students with a quiet place 在说什么？

choices.label: 为学生提供安静的学习地点
choices.why: provide A with B 表示给 A 提供 B。

choices.label: 要求学生保持安静
choices.why: 句中没有 require；provide 表示提供。

variants.sentence: The course provides beginners with several useful examples.
variants.prompt: 这句话中被提供的内容是什么？

choices.label: several useful examples
choices.why: provide beginners with 后面的内容就是所提供的东西。

items.sentence: Sleep can affect how well students remember new words.

choices.label: 影响
choices.why: 睡眠会影响学生记忆新词的效果。

variants.sentence: Road noise can affect how well people sleep.

items.sentence: Regular practice often results in better performance.
items.prompt: result in 在这句话中表示什么？

choices.label: 起因于
choices.why: result from 才表示起因于。

choices.label: 反对
choices.why: 这里表达因果，不是立场。

variants.sentence: Missing the final bus resulted in an expensive taxi ride.

choices.label: 导致后来不得不坐昂贵的出租车

items.sentence: Online courses give workers an opportunity to learn at home.
items.prompt: an opportunity to learn 指什么？

choices.label: 学习的机会
choices.why: opportunity to do 表示做某事的机会。

variants.sentence: The trip gave us an opportunity to practise English.

choices.label: 练习英语的机会
choices.why: opportunity to do 是做某事的机会。

items.sentence: A short walk can improve your mood after a busy day.
items.prompt: improve your mood 表示什么？

choices.label: 改善心情
choices.why: improve 表示使某事变得更好。

variants.sentence: Regular feedback helps people improve their work.

items.sentence: The guide supports new users during their first week.
items.prompt: supports new users 更接近哪个意思？

choices.label: 帮助新用户
choices.why: support 在这里表示提供帮助。

variants.sentence: Good public transport supports local businesses.

choices.label: 有助于当地商家
choices.why: 交通为商家提供有利条件。

items.sentence: This job requires basic computer skills.
items.prompt: requires basic computer skills 表示什么？

choices.label: 这份工作需要基本电脑技能
choices.why: require 表示需要、要求具备。

choices.label: 这份工作教授电脑技能
这份工作禁止使用电脑

variants.sentence: The form requires your name and phone number.

choices.label: 表格要求填写这些信息
choices.why: required information 是必须提供的信息。

items.sentence: The new timetable allows students to leave earlier on Friday.
items.prompt: allows students to leave earlier 表示什么？

choices.label: 允许学生更早离开
choices.why: allow someone to do 是允许某人做某事。

choices.label: 建议学生迟到
choices.why: 句中没有 suggest 或 arrive late。

variants.sentence: Online booking allows customers to choose a time.

items.sentence: A doctor is available until six this evening.
items.prompt: is available until six 表示什么？

choices.label: 医生六点前可以接诊
choices.why: available 表示有空或可获得。

variants.sentence: The report is available online for free.

choices.label: 只能在线购买
choices.why: for free 说明无需购买。

items.sentence: Turning off unused lights can reduce energy costs.
items.prompt: reduce energy costs 表示什么？

variants.sentence: A clear list reduces the chance of forgetting something.
variants.prompt: reduces the chance 表示什么？
